    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            components.append((color, cells))

    def is_rectangle_frame(cells):
        ys = [y for y, x in cells]
        xs = [x for y, x in cells]
        top, bottom, left, right = min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)
        border = ({(top, x) for x in range(left, right + 1)} |
                  {(bottom, x) for x in range(left, right + 1)} |
                  {(y, left) for y in range(top, bottom + 1)} |
                  {(y, right) for y in range(top, bottom + 1)})
        return set(cells) == border

    output = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    # Frames travel to the top edge; all other objects travel to the bottom.
    for frames in (True, False):
        group = [(color, cells) for color, cells in components
                 if is_rectangle_frame(cells) == frames]
        group.sort(key=lambda item: min(y for y, x in item[1])
                   if frames else -max(y for y, x in item[1]))
        for color, cells in group:
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)

                    break
                shift += step
